scope: Existing initial corpus: 868 Problem documents, 248 frozen shards, accepted 232 Unit mapping. No new Problem prose is authored in this change.
inspectionBasis: Retained the tracked PR #65 full-corpus prose inspections and all 21 correction records. Inspected the original, second, third and final correction records and the current reasoning/proof/complexity of the three risk-bearing shards without extra sourceVerification records.
Recomputed every shard's current subject and input/source/skill binding; compared every correctness Claim with its owning prose, allowing only Markdown coefficient-bracket escaping.

Ran all 20 independent finite-model mathematical regressions. The regressions verify actual boundary/coefficient/order cases and several current prose tables. They do not establish arbitrary-input correctness by themselves.

Checked unique primary Outcome ownership, direct membership and accepted reading order, ancestral coverage and additional-primary/supporting related references against the authored Units. Ancestor owners already in the home subtree need no duplicate related link.
Checked that optional example/exercise blocks are absent, prose pseudocode is not claimed to have executed, and retired preview example/answer locators are recorded as absent on their actual owner.

Kept all original_proof and official_source_conflict reasons and recorded source rechecks. Earlier explanation errors, supplements to the official argument and genuinely conflicting claims remain traceable rather than being erased by the owner waiver.

targetedReasoningChecks.basis: Endpoint colors define the 2x2 transition, out-of-range binomial coefficients are zero, trace closes the cycle, and each coloring has a unique common white count. D=1 and k=0,D+1 remain legal. The full algorithm counts D+2 powers and the O(D) coefficient storage.

The divisibility-layer difference isolates exact 2-adic valuation. Registering the current value before querying includes i=j once. A=(1,3) gives odd parts 1+1+3=5; registering after querying without a diagonal correction would give 1. This is a correction to earlier authoring, not a reason to overwrite official source revisions.

One complete row is a right rotation. Two full rows for N=4 give [4,3,1,2]; whole-suffix reversal followed by reversal of the remaining suffix matches this. Both partial boundary rows and the same-row case are retained.

Persistent append uses node[x_i] directly and creates at most one trie node. Terminals before children and labels in ascending order implement lexicographic order, with duplicate indices ascending. Expanding parent arrays or walking them from the root on each append would make the chain quadratic.

Small index/value differences partition every index by its residue class. Wrapping is the only break of the arithmetic progression. The N<=D branch, gcd reduction, negative direction and multiplication/addition-only geometric-sum composition avoid unjustified modular division.

The learned algorithm is Lucy DP followed by descending-prime, descending-quotient table updates. Constant-many sieves for prime sums and O(1) prime-power evaluation give O(N^(3/4)/log N) time and O(sqrt(N)) space. The faster N^(2/3) variant is not an attained Outcome. The canonical Tag, Outcome, Unit overview and Problem learning position now agree with the existing complexity derivation and official editorial 10869.

Tutte evaluation/interpolation requires field elimination, invertible modular denominators and the nonzero-polynomial error bound. The formal Tag/Outcome/Unit prerequisites and Problem additionalPrerequisiteUnitIds now lead to linear-system-rank, modular-arithmetic and randomized-algorithms. These Units teach the row update, inverse conditions and Schwartz–Zippel argument; interpolation and Tutte-specific reasoning remain in the matching Unit.

limitations: This accepts the existing, source-bound corpus using the recorded prose reviews and rerun independent regressions. It does not assert human self-study, third-party approval, maximum-input execution of 868 submission programs, public projection or production release acceptance. Updating any joined subject requires a new explicit quality review; --write cannot renew this record.
